claims.visible_claim: Big Five research supports describing individual differences with continuous dimensions ([S1](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2283588/)). This page’s “High Openness to Experience: active curiosity, exploration, and approach to new experience” is this package’s interpretive range for a continuous score. It is not a diagnostic category, ability level, career-fit conclusion, or percentile claim unsupported by public norms. Different instruments may report raw scores, standardized scores, percentiles, or range labels; those outputs are not directly interchangeable.
claims.boundary: Supports a continuous domain, not product norms, ability, career fit, or individual prediction.

claims.boundary: Group averages do not predict an individual trajectory or intervention effect.
